Preserve the brief statement about the fragrance of a sacred place.
shortened: The Fragrances of the Holy-Spirit waft from this Sacred Spot. If the nostrils were open they could inhale these breaths. This Blessed Land is fragrant.

order.why: Read the reported connection of land purchase with scriptural associations.
Keep the reported proposal concerning Tiberias and its lake.
Read the extended account of Gadara and vanished grandeur with its recorded chronology.
shortened: Where are now those Greek Kings and Roman Imperators and Queenly ladies who lived in their palaces, danced in the moonlight and bathed in the hot springs of this valley? They laid the foundations of these stately buildings so deep and they reared their walls so high that they vainly thought the hand of time will not touch them. How would they feel if their ghosts returned and looked upon this dismal picture of complete desolation! The wild, roving Arabs pitching their tents in the ruins of those gorgeous palaces, they have become the dung-heaps of animals and men, stables for their asses and horses! Such sights give one much thought for reflection and contemplation!

order.why: Retain the reported pyramid-excavation story.
Hear the remembered patriotic claim about the pyramids.
Keep the brief account of Mani’s designs and the carpet.
Preserve the separately reported version of those treasures.
Retain the account of vanished tribes and remembered traditions.
Read the letter about forgotten prophets and Caucasia.
Keep the reported claims about Jesus and Gospel traditions attributed.
Preserve the reported Nero example as a judgment on civilization.
Consider the reported relation of language to a people’s freedom.
Retain the particular remembered episode in Tanta.
Keep the original selection about immediate difficulties and unrest.
shortened: Abdul-Baha has utmost joy at your presence, however affairs in these parts have become very difficult and in Adasiyyih and other places grievous events are occurring one after another. Those who are present have absolutely no rest and are greatly troubled.

order.why: Consider how descendants may judge the conduct of ancestors.
shortened: Reflect upon the condition of those who came before - the truth will become evident and the end result will become clear. Children and descendants became disgusted with their sinful fathers and ancestors and were ashamed of their connection to them.

order.why: Ask what opportunities for lasting service influential people possessed.
Contrast comfort with the enduring light of faithfulness.
shortened: Consider the early centuries - some souls lived in the utmost comfort and prosperity, and finally left behind the troubles of the world, while other souls who experienced various forms of cruelty in the path of faithfulness - their lights still shine bright from the horizon of the Kingdom, and their radiance, like the rays of the morning star, remains manifest and evident from the divine dawning-place.

order.why: Let the quoted lesson of predecessors reopen the meaning of gain and loss.
shortened: Consider what the Arab poet has said: "Our insights are given us by those who came before us." In other words the past offers us a lesson in this regard for consider what little benefit it was to souls who passed the days of their lives in the utmost comfort and joy and ask thyself what real loss was suffered by others who spent their time afflicted by hardship in the path of God, the Revealer of verses.

order.why: Read earlier sacrifice as an invitation to follow a path.
Attend to the conduct through which earlier souls served.
shortened: Look at the good, pure, and blessed souls in the early centuries - with what conduct and behavior, what detachment and extreme attraction they spread the divine fragrances and exalted the Word of God. "In those who have gone before in former ages, there are examples for us."

order.why: Consider steadfastness through persecution and its later fruits.
shortened: Look unto those who have been in the former ages--how they have resisted all nations and suffered all persecutions and afflictions, and how their stars shone, their attacks proved successful, their teachings established, their regions expanded, their hearts gladdened, their ideas cleared and their motives effective.

order.why: Keep the reported example of the disciples’ sustained dedication.
Close the source-linked sequence with the invitation to lift the tree’s branches.
Emphasize the present opportunity that cannot simply be recovered later.
shortened: Whatsoever hath occurred in the past, its remedy in this Day is easy and simple, but that which is missed by anyone today shall be impossible to remedy.

order.why: Introduce the supplied appeal to study Nabil’s narrative.
End with the supplied appeal to use historical reading to sustain enthusiasm and action.

subjects.displayTitle: Light and darkness: seeing, receiving, and illuminating a life
subjects.introduction: Love is light wherever it dwells, and hatred is darkness wherever it nests: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá turns the oldest of images into a test that can be applied to any room, any friendship, any heart. From there the subject opens outward. Sunlight reveals the world yet cannot understand it; the light of the intellect sees and knows; the light of guidance is born of God Himself. The heart is a glass and the human reality a niche, so that receiving light and giving it become one movement, as the Qur’án’s parable of the lamp already suggests [1]. Darkness, in this teaching, is not a rival power but an absence, which is why prejudice, selfishness and oppression can be dispelled rather than fought on their own terms. The dark pupil gathers light, the beloved’s dark hair conceals radiance, and colour refuses to hold still as a symbol. To walk this way is to learn what it means to become a source of light for others, to ask what guidance really is, and to discover, in the question of whether evil exists at all, why the night must pass.
subjects.arc: Begin with love, perception and the heart’s capacity; explore the layered language of light and darkness, revelation and receptivity; move through obstacles and trials toward justice, unity, service and prayer.

order.why: Open with the ethical test of love and hatred wherever they appear.
shortened: In this way, the light of divine guidance will shine forth, and the blessings of God will cradle all mankind: for love is light, no matter in what abode it dwelleth; and hate is darkness, no matter where it may make its nest. O friends of God! That the hidden Mystery may stand revealed, and the secret essence of all things may be disclosed, strive ye to banish that darkness for ever and ever.

order.why: Let a lit room make the revealing power of love tangible.
shortened: At night, when a lamp is brought into a room, all things at once become manifest, and such is the power of love.

order.why: Challenge a rigid color symbolism through the praise of Louis Gregory.
Distinguish visible light from the light of understanding.
shortened: There are two kinds of light. There is the visible light of the sun, by whose aid we can discern the beauties of the world around us -- without this we could see nothing.
It is the light of the intellect which gives us knowledge and understanding, and without this light the physical eyes would be useless.
This light of the intellect is the highest light that exists, for it is born of the Light Divine.

order.why: Set beside it the reported fourfold account of light.
shortened: He said:

"The light is of four kinds: first, the light of the sun. It reveals objects to our perception, but cannot itself realize them. Second, the light of the eye. It can realize objects, but cannot understand them. Third, the light of wisdom. This both realizes and understand objects. Fourth, the Light of Guidance. This is the Supreme Light, the conscious Reality which comprehends mysteries."

order.why: Join knowledge and love in the crystal heart.
shortened: O thou well-known and renowned Baha'i! That heart of crystal has, praise be to God, become a lamp of light. And since both knowledge and love have combined within it, light upon light has become manifest and apparent.

order.why: Introduce capacity and the lamp as mutually illuminating images.
Make conduct the means by which the world becomes luminous.
shortened: I swear by the Ancient Beauty and the Most Great Name that if we move and behave according to the divine counsels and admonitions, and our deeds and words conform to the commands of the Chosen Beauty, this dark world will become a luminous realm and this abode of nothingness will become a radiant world of existence and a place where divine signs are made manifest.

order.why: Name reconciliation and the removal of prejudice as concrete forms of illumination.
shortened: Thou must instruct the people of the world in the Love of God, that they may eradicate the foundation of warfare and strife, be attracted by the Glad-tidings of the Kingdom of Abha, lay the basis of love and amity, raise the melody of amity, and the oneness of the Kingdom of humanity; transmute tyranny and persecution into love and faithfulness, efface the traces of bloodshed and carnage; construct the edifice of reconciliation, dispel the darkness of estrangement, diffuse the light of unity; change the poison of animosity into the honey of sympathetic affection; destroy the religious, national and social prejudices from the individuals of humanity; live and act, with and toward each other as though they were from one race, one country, one religion, and one kind.

order.why: Find a hopeful star within every heart.
Explore darkness as the absence of light.
Keep the separately reported application to evil.
Retain the short reported statement of absence.
Preserve the paired examples of darkness and blindness.
shortened: The non-existence of light is darkness. The lack of sight is blindness.

order.why: Keep the concise formulation in its own source.
Consider the distinction between light arriving and darkness changing substance.
Read deficiency and divine attributes as two aspects of experience.
Allow the reported reflection to acknowledge the limits of understanding evil.
shortened: O my sister, here we come up against the mystery of evil, the mystery of wickedness, which our limited understanding, our earth-bound senses, cannot solve in this earthly life. But if we gaze with burning eyes into the darkness of this abyss, it is given - at least to the sincere seeker after God - to receive an enlightening glimmer of understanding here and there in the darkness of evil.

order.why: Notice that sunlight reveals objects without knowing them.
Read the reported warning against reducing spiritual light to physical radiation.
Keep the source’s physical vocabulary beside its spiritual comparison.
shortened: O resplendent lamp! What light more luminous than that of the love of God? What ray more effulgent than that of the knowledge of God? The external light is created by waves in the ether It is an accident that emanates from light-giving bodies and it enables objects to become visible and apparent to the sight.

order.why: Contrast the limited reach of an electric lamp with the celestial image.
shortened: O luminous lamp! The greatest of lamps, the electric light, nevertheless illumines only a limited distance nearby for several hours and miles. But the celestial lamp shines like the brilliant morning light unto the horizons, its light spreading from the earthly kingdom to the heavenly kingdom, and its radiance extending from the Supreme Concourse to the human realm.

order.why: Consider the transience of an ordinary torch.
shortened: O ignited candle! Shouldst thou kindle a mortal torch, its light would, of necessity, be transient and the circle of thy union lit by a dreary lamp, a spluttering taper. Such material illumination may last until the break of day but by the following dusk it will have been extinguished.

order.why: Read the reported practical conversation about waiting for electricity.
Ask what turns a furnished room or gathering into a luminous place.
shortened: No matter how small is a room and how simply it is furnished, yet when a candle is ignited therein we exclaim 'the room is lighted!' Therefore you must make an effort to enkindle the lamp of guidance in your hearts, otherwise a well furnished room without lamp, a heart without spirituality and a meeting without the power of the Love of God are anomalies.

order.why: Preserve the particular reported domestic comparison.
Read earthly understanding beside the claimed brilliance of revelation.
shortened: It is evident and manifest unto every discerning observer that even as the light of the star fadeth before the effulgent splendor of the sun, so doth the luminary of earthly knowledge, of wisdom, and understanding vanish into nothingness when brought face to face with the resplendent glories of the Sun of Truth, the Daystar of divine enlightenment.

order.why: Seek the day that is not followed by night.
shortened: The worth of day appears through night, and its station shines through darkness. The lamp of night speaks of and indicates its station, while day itself reveals and manifests the station of day. Yet night stands opposite to day, and day opposite to night - both are limited. We seek a day that has no night following it, one illumined by the light of the Beloved's face, not by the light of sun or moon.

order.why: Contrast the alternating earth with the enduring light of heart and soul.
shortened: This earthly realm is sometimes dark and sometimes light, but praise be to God, the world of heart and soul is ever shining and bright through heavenly grace. Glory be to God! The earthly globe is always half light and half dark, but the pure heart and soul are ever luminous.

order.why: Keep the brief contrast of night and day radiance.
Notice the paradox of a dawn that makes a candle more visible.
shortened: O candle of the love of God! The luminous morn of guidance is rising and shining from the horizon of the Supreme Concourse. What is wonderful is that this bright morn causes the appearance of the lights of the luminous lamps, and from the spreading of the gleam of that dawn, the light of the candle becomes more manifest and evident.

order.why: Read darkness as the outer veil of beauty in the Tablet of the Hair.
Explore the paired light, darkness, water and fire images without flattening them.
Explains light and darkness as sensible images of knowledge and ignorance.
Retain the Bab’s distinctive reflection on the name of Light.
Place light within the extended praise of divine creative sovereignty.
shortened: Blessed be He in Whose grasp is the kingdom of the beauty of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever lieth between them, and He is the Creator, the All-Beautiful. Blessed be He in Whose grasp is the kingdom of the majesty of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever lieth between them, and He is the Creator, the All-Glorious. Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the kingdom of the light of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and verily He is the Manifest Creator!

order.why: Keep the Bab’s account of causes and the source’s visible omission.
shortened: He createth whatsoever He willeth by His command. He is indeed the Powerful, the Mighty, the Sovereign. Say: Verily God causeth the causes to flow without a cause and createth them anew even as He created them the first time. All are subservient unto Him, all worship Him. Say: Verily everything within its bounds is a cause for the creation of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, but ye do not perceive. Were it not for the ink whose splendor...[nothing would exist. How then do ye acquire what is ordained in the heavens and earth and whatsoever lieth between them?

order.why: Hear the explicit Qur’anic allusion to divine light.
Read the niche and stars with the supplied footnote and its incomplete syntax.
shortened: At this time when the effulgence of that Self-Subsisting Sun [Baha'u'llah] hath from the unseen aspect of existence cast its rays across the earth and heaven and irradiated the farthest horizons with its dawning lights of primal unity, such souls as have sought shelter beneath His all embracing Word should themselves become as resplendent stars. They should become scintillating suns that all the lamps of existence may be illumined through these rays that emanate from the divine light "Its similitude is that of a niche in which there is a lamp [footnote: Qur'anic verse of light]
The radiance streaming forth from this point of dawn is like a lamp in this material world.

order.why: Let crystal and lamp describe a responsive human reality.
Move the candle of guidance into the glass of the heart.
shortened: O thou who art illumined by the light of divine guidance!
When the candle of guidance is kindled within the glass of the heart, it dispels the darkness of error that stems from worldly limitations.

order.why: Keep the direct address to one whose inner lamp is lit.
Let the window of the heart receive the rays.
shortened: From the Dawning-Place of Lights, such brilliant rays struck the window of your heart that the darkness of error was eclipsed and the great light of guidance became manifest.

order.why: Connect recognition with steadfastness to the Covenant.
shortened: Light the lamp of recognition in the glass of heart and soul, and raise high the banner of the Covenant.

order.why: Consider the soul’s capacity to receive illumination.
shortened: But when light is poured upon this phase, and if this phase of the soul is capable of receiving it, then "truth hath come and falsehood vanisheth, for falsehood is of short duration" -otherwise, darkness will surround it from all directions and it will be deprived of association with the Supreme Concourse and will remain in the lowest depths.

order.why: Read guidance as bringing latent capacities into visibility.
Distinguish failing to recognize a person from rejecting divine perfections.
shortened: If a soul distances himself from the Manifestation, he may yet be awakened, for he may have failed to know Him and to recognize Him as the Embodiment of the divine perfections. But if he loathes the divine perfections themselves, which are the Holy Spirit, this shows that, bat-like, he is a hater of the light.

order.why: Consider attachment to night when daylight arrives.
shortened: Be ye ashamed before God and war not against His Self, deny not His power, dispute not His verses, and take not your idle fancies as objects of worship besides Him. Among these are those who love not the Day because their souls have grown accustomed to the Night, and when the Day appeareth it obliterateth its traces and radiance until no vestige thereof remaineth visible.

order.why: Ask how desire may veil an apparent light.
shortened: How many a darkness hath been illumined by the splendors of the Countenance, and how many a light hath been veiled through following its desires!

order.why: Keep the reported warning about self and ego as clouds.
shortened: I wish for them this illumination. I desire for them this luminosity; so that they may rejoice the hearts and spiritualize the souls - but alas! How often they let the cloud of self and ego becloud the horizon and thus prevent the stars of their divine verities from shinning!

order.why: Read the slumber of fancy as an obstacle to perception.
Notice the contrast between an open gate and unawareness.
Preserve the poetic image of feeling heat without seeing light.
shortened: "The blind eye finds naught from the shining sun's rays save heat." They have eyes but do not see with them, and ears but do not hear with them.

order.why: Keep the source’s bat imagery and its contrast of capacities.
shortened: The rays of divine manifestation have spread like the gleaming dawn and its effulgence has struck both sight and insight. Every eye and insight that possessed the power of vision was illumined, while those weak of sight and limited in insight, lacking the power of vision, shut their eyes and, like bats, crept into the cave of darkness.

order.why: Retain the separate comparison of seeing eyes and bats.
Read the warning about selfish desire alongside the warmth of love.
shortened: O thou bird of knowledge, lift up voice and chant thy melodies in the garden of the divine Covenant and O thou phoenix of certitude, illumine thou thy eyes with rays from the luminary of divine bounties. They who follow their selfish desires are like bats which cover their faces and hide themselves from the light when it shine upon them. The fire of the love of God will melt away all coldness and frigidity.

order.why: Keep the strongly contrasting creature images in their source setting.
Preserve the sharp reproach concerning closed eyes.
shortened: Shame upon them and away with them, for they have closed their eyes to the lights and walked in the darkness of a pitch-black night in this age of illumination.

order.why: Read the repeated darkness within the image of a concealing veil.
shortened: By thy life! The Sun of Reality, from the Kingdom of its invisibility, bestoweth its lights and rays upon all horizons. Yet those who are veiled remain behind a dark, gloomy, and pitch-black veil - darkness upon darkness upon darkness - and they find no guidance.

order.why: Keep the Covenant-specific polemical application identifiable.
shortened: The dream you saw is a remedy for every ailing sufferer, but a thousand proofs cannot overcome the vain imaginings of any Covenant-breaker, for to those of bat-like nature, the brilliant rays of the Sun of Truth cause blindness of sight and provoke anger.

order.why: Retain the contrast of radiance and failed hearing or seeing.
shortened: The light of truth hath radiated from the Sun of Divinity to the horizons in such a manner that the East and the West are illumined. But, alas! the blind do not see and the deaf do not hear the divine proclamation.

order.why: Read encompassing bounty alongside the condition of being veiled.
shortened: Praise be to God that the hidden outpourings have encompassed the realm of existence from all directions, and the effulgent lights from the Abha Kingdom have illumined the sanctified spiritual realities. Strange it is that the veiled ones are overcome by the darkness of blindness, and the concealed ones are hidden behind the veils of concealment.

order.why: Keep the image of a smiling dawn and unresponsive people.
shortened: O thou who art attracted by the fragrances of God! The morn of the bounties of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, hath dawned, risen, shone forth and become manifest from the horizons of creation, and the daybreak hath smiled with the lights of certitude, while the people remain in layers of darkness one above another, their eyes blind and their ears deaf.

order.why: Retain the source’s contrasting responses to the risen sun.
Read the reported preference for candlelit rooms over sunlight.
shortened: The Sun of Reality is in the height of its power and majesty but they prefer dark rooms and the light of the candles.

order.why: Keep the gardener’s reported question and the source’s unfinished reply.
Hear the lament of one whose attempt to illuminate meets hostility.
shortened: And whenever I seek to illuminate them with the lights of Thy countenance to deliver them from the darkness of their own selves, they flee and conspire to slay me.

order.why: Consider the setting in which tyranny makes concealment necessary.
Read the paradox of imprisoned Light and a silenced Speaker.
shortened: O Hasan! The Light is imprisoned in darkness, and the Speaker of the Mount is forbidden to speak, for the ears of the world are occupied with listening to unworthy tales, while the Tongue of Truth uttereth Its own praise and pondereth upon Its manifestation and mysteries and signs.

order.why: Keep the hope of divine light amid oppression.
shortened: The darkness of oppression hath encompassed the world. God willing, ye shall not in this darkness be deprived of the lights of the divine Day.

order.why: Read knowledge’s illumination beside the obscuring dust of hearts.
Preserve the prayer’s concise description of encompassing darkness.
shortened: How long shalt Thou behold these things and tarry, O my God? Darkness hath enveloped the whole earth, and Thy tokens are ready to be blotted out throughout Thy realm.

order.why: Attend to the specific concern about the world of morality.
Keep the warning of calamities hidden in the world of nature.
Read the need for a dawn beyond that darkness.
shortened: For the darkness of the world of nature is intense; until the light of the Most Glorious Kingdom encompasses all, the bright morn of reality will not shine forth from the darkness of the natural world.

order.why: Place hope in guidance alongside the recognition of present darkness.
Ask what can dispel sorrow’s night.
shortened: For this pitch darkness a dispeller is needed, and for these devastating trials a remover is required. For darkness there can be no dispeller save light, and for the sorrowful darkness of night there can be no remover save the luminous lamp.

order.why: Read glad tidings as lamps amid ordeals.
shortened: The ordeals of this mortal world are like unto a dark night and the Glad-tidings like the brilliant lamps. If mankind live in this darkness without the light of these lamps, unquestionably they will perish through the intensity of grief and affliction.

order.why: Explore spiritual happiness through a sequence of contrasts.
shortened: Spiritual happiness is light, while sorrow is darkness.
This happiness is glad-tidings, while sorrow is disappointment.
This happiness is the Kingdom while sorrow is the earthly world.
This happiness is life, while sorrow is non-existence.

order.why: Keep the contrast of gloom and faith within its devotional setting.
shortened: Man, in the darkness of error, finds naught but grief and gloom. He is ever despairing, sorrowful and heavy-hearted. But when the light of faith shines forth in the realm of the heart, eternal joy appears and the darkness of sorrow and gloom vanishes away.

order.why: Read the reported hope of sorrow’s end in the Kingdom.
Consider the change of vision through which thorns become roses.
Introduce forgiveness as a transforming radiance.
Keep the particular prayer for release from gloom.
shortened: Grant peace to Isfandiyar-i-Bahram, make him of good name, bestow heavenly messages upon him, make him joyous, deliver him from the darkness of gloom, and make him like the bright morning light.

order.why: Let remembrance illuminate the heart during the night.
See persons as candles within a cloudy, smoky city.
shortened: Thanks be to God! that in that city which is often dark because of cloud, mist and smoke, such bright candles (as you) are glowing, whose emanating light is God's guidance, and whose influencing warmth is as the burning Fire of the Love of God.

order.why: Retain the affectionate address to remembered friends.
Keep the family’s shared illumination in its personal setting.
Read the call to two people to become luminous.
shortened: Now the intent is that you should become like two celestial figures, bright and luminous, and shine forth in the zenith of the All-Merciful.

order.why: Distinguish imagined celestial figures from the desired reality of steadfast persons.
shortened: Those two figures are mere imagination, but you two figures shall, God willing, be two real figures in the heaven of steadfastness to the Covenant, so that from the brilliance of your stellar light the circle of the equator, nay rather the temperate zone, may be illumined.

order.why: Preserve the particular Turkish address and its gladness.
Keep the Bahram imagery within its own symbolic vocabulary.
Widen the horizon to the awaited dawn across religious communities.
shortened: Every people awaits the dawning of the Sun of Truth from the horizon of hope, every sect watches for the appearance of brilliant lights from a most luminous dayspring, and every people is promised the manifestation of the Lord of existence - the One promised to the Jews, the One awaited by the people of the Gospel through the grace of the Loving Lord, the One whose appearance in the visible realm was foretold in the tongue of the Praised One Muhammad - so that by His dawning from the horizon of the world, the intense darkness may be dispelled and the dense clouds over the horizons of the nations may be removed, and the forces of ignorance may be scattered while the angel of knowledge and virtue prevails, and those possessed of true understanding may be empowered while the helpers of failure are dispersed, and the morn of guidance may appear and the lamp of wisdom may shine forth, and every crookedness may be straightened and every deviation set right, and all doubts may vanish and the veils may be lifted from the face of reality.

order.why: Read the light of divine unity amid encompassing darkness.
shortened: The light of divine unity hath shone forth when darkness had encompassed all creatures - this is a bounty whose mention all pens are powerless to make. The limbs of darkness have trembled at this light shining from the horizon of this station.

order.why: Retain the seal’s designation of the Lamp of Guidance.
Connect the shining Book with insight and guidance.
Imagine knowledge illuminating the heaven of utterance.
shortened: Thus have We illumined the heaven of utterance with the Sun of knowledge.

order.why: Read a revealed word as a measure of conduct.
shortened: Through one blessed word that shone forth from the Dayspring of the mouth of the All-Merciful, the measure of all people's deeds became clear and evident, and through that same word a distinction was drawn between the righteous and the wicked, and between the people of Paradise and of the Fire.

order.why: Preserve the account of differing responses to the Ancient Light.
shortened: The peoples shall differ regarding this Ancient Light, and hatred shall appear among them concerning this Mighty Pillar, that the good may be distinguished from the evil, and light from darkness.

order.why: Read manifestation as grace and the turning of faces.
Attend to trustworthiness and justice in the distinction between light and fire.
Keep the brief call to distinguish competing influences.
shortened: Today the whispers of Satan are evident and the breezes of the All-Merciful are wafting. Cast off the former and take hold of the latter.

order.why: Seek unity beyond the limitations of transient dwellings.
shortened: From the ruined, transient, limited houses, seek refuge in the mighty pillar of unity, and shunning darknesses above darknesses, hold fast and cling to manifestation above manifestation, radiance above radiance, and light above light.

order.why: Read the dawning Luminary through its extended movement across nations.
Keep the concise announcement of universal radiance.
Preserve the sweeping dawn image within its source.
shortened: O luminous friends of Abdul-Baha! When the Sun of Truth shone forth from the horizon of oneness with an unprecedented luminosity, it illumined all regions. East and West became bright and radiant, and North and South were lit with a brilliant dawn. No darkness remained and no error truly persisted.

order.why: Read the ray that tears through veils.
shortened: The Sun of Truth with one ray rent asunder and destroyed all those veils and shrouds, and shone so brilliantly at the meridian of the heavens that the contingent world became illumined with the lights of the realm of the unconstrained, and the dark dwelling of the horizons became resplendent with the effulgence of the Supreme Horizon.

order.why: Let a single effulgence and breath renew East and West.
Retain the separate short declaration of worldwide illumination.
Keep the image of light coming from the unseen Kingdom.
shortened: And the Holy Temple of the Most Glorious Beauty has been established upon the throne of grandeur and power, and the lights have shone forth from the Kingdom of the Unseen, and the rays of that effulgence have encompassed all regions.

order.why: Read the reported sequence of sun, gates and encompassing bounty.
shortened: The Sun of Reality has shone forth, the gates of the Kingdom have opened, divine bestowals have become manifest, heavenly outpourings have encompassed all.

order.why: Join the morning landscape to the dawning heart.
Keep the interrupted cry of glad tidings and the movement toward knowledge.
Read light together with stirred speech and watered hearts.
Keep thanksgiving for a particular village’s dawn.
shortened: I offer thanks to God for in that village the light of truth shone forth and the sun of guidance arose.

order.why: Let the text’s repeated questions invite recognition of radiance.
Preserve the differing responses to the sun of love and kindness.
Read the richly layered description of joy and recognition.
Keep the dawn within the passage’s resurrection imagery.
Retain the concise affirmation of darkness passing.
Read the personal transition from darkness to light.
shortened: You were unaware of the Kingdom of Heaven and became aware. You were deprived of the breaths of the Holy Spirit and received an abundant share. You hastened from the world of darkness to the world of light.

order.why: Keep the direct address of guidance and renewed life.
Hear that transition in the servant’s prayer.
shortened: This thy servant hath abandoned superstitions, emerged from darkness and hath entered into Thy Light which hath shone forth to the world!

order.why: Read the invitation to rejoice and receive light.
Connect response to the Call with attention to the horizon.
shortened: O thou who hast heard the Call and hast responded, "Here am I, O my Lord, the Most Glorious!" If thou wouldst direct thy gaze to the most exalted horizon, thou wouldst witness the lights of the Kingdom of Abha that have illumined the horizons of creation.

order.why: Keep the brief invitation to the light in the glass of ascension.
Retain the promised radiance and lamp of acceptance.
shortened: And thou shalt see beneath the shade of the Tree that which shall dispel the darkness of obscurity with brilliant rays and a lamp that was luminous with the light of acceptance.

order.why: Let the abundance of guidance lead to humility in thanksgiving.
shortened: O manifestation of the greatest guidance! If you were to open a hundred thousand tongues in thanksgiving to God that the dawn of guidance has broken, the light of truth has shone forth, and soul and heart have attained their utmost desire, you would still fall short in offering thanks and find no recourse except to express helplessness and supplication.

order.why: Keep gratitude for lit lamps and quickened souls.
Read the reported continuity of divine favor.
shortened: The light of divine favor is shining and will shine from century to century.

order.why: Preserve the assurance that clouds cannot prevent the promised effects.
Keep the image of radiance beyond concealment.
shortened: O thou who art guided by the Supreme Guidance!
The Sun of Truth hath not shone forth from the Horizon of Oneness with such radiance that Its rays could be concealed by the veils of the people of contingent being.

order.why: Read ancient power through the dispersal of night.
Ask what contingent darkness can do against divine light.
shortened: What can earthly power do against celestial might? And what can contingent darkness accomplish against divine light?

order.why: Keep the emphatic rhetorical question concerning light’s power.
shortened: Can darkness ever obliterate the light or is it not light that overcomes the darkness? What vain imaginings are these! What foolish thoughts of ignorant minds!

order.why: Read inspiration as overcoming delusion.
shortened: But observe how the power of divine revelation has always overcome delusions and the lights of inspiration have dispelled darkness.

order.why: Retain the stated power of spirituality amid contrary forces.
Keep the strongly polemical contrasts attributed to their source.
shortened: Darkness cannot face the light, and Satan the loser cannot resist the brilliant meteor, and the filthy dung beetle cannot prevent the sweet fragrance of the Most Glorious Paradise.

order.why: Read the Covenant imagery and textual uncertainty without alteration.
shortened: O ye loved ones of God! When the Star of the Covenant and the radiant Morn shone forth from the Covenant of the worlds(?), the eyes of the lovers were illumined, their hearts gladdened and their breasts, even as the wilderness of Sinai, have found delight through the effulgent glory.
And when yet others began uttering idle words such as, "The darkness prevaileth over the light," the Morn of Truth hath been shedding its radiance in the plenitude of its resplendency.
The sorry birds of darkness have become the bondslaves of ignominy and torment!

order.why: Preserve the image of routed darkness in its rhetorical setting.
Keep the martial image of heavenly hosts within its devotional source.
shortened: Glad tidings follow one upon another from the Abha Kingdom, and a mighty host like a devastating flood surges forth from the Supreme Concourse, engaging fiercely in battle with the forces of darkness, plunging into the depths of struggle and combat.

order.why: Retain the related imagery of contention and radiance.
Read the reported army’s swords as words and its armament as heavenly.
Make explicit the reported contrast between life-giving and destructive struggle.
Explore the extended martial metaphor directed toward service and knowledge.
shortened: However, martyrdom is to give up one's life once and race to the highest heaven, but it is even more pleasant on this plane to sacrifice a hundred thousand lives at every moment with utmost joy and delight, to arise to serve the Cause of the Lord of Oneness, to charge into the field of valor and guidance, to scatter the forces of error and darkness through the lights of the Dawning-Place of Oneness, to break apart the ranks of the army of heedlessness, to arrange the spiritual battle lines, to organize the army of inner meanings, to raise high the banner of knowledge, to launch a mighty attack upon the forces of ignorance and unawareness, and then, having returned victorious from this struggle, to set out for the feast of the Abha Kingdom, advancing with drums and retinue and parasol and standard, hastening to the Abha Kingdom with perfect gladness and bounties, with drums and verses of triumph and victory and banners of ascendancy and conquest - this is more pleasant and more attractive.

order.why: Read the scholar’s knowledge, arts and exposition as means of spiritual endeavor.
shortened: O distinguished and eminent scholar, verily the Greatest Name and the Most Ancient Light has cast unto you the keys to the gates of the hearts of the world and the keys to unlock the hearts of all peoples, so that you might commence with divine victories and commentaries upon the texts of consciousness, and expand your breast with the light of knowledge, and illuminate your heart with the lamp of arts, and brighten your face with the radiance of the All-Merciful, and cause you to speak with the essence of utterance and the reality of exposition, and scatter from your mouth luminous and unique gems and brilliant pearls of praise, and cause to flow from the spring of your nature the pure water of Paradise, and cause to gush forth from the wellsprings of your being the fountains of wisdom and the heavenly stream, so that in this time you might stride forth in the arena and loose the reins and raise the spears and scatter the forces of darkness and disperse the gathering of the base, and charge through the ranks and attack the thousands, and light the lamp of guidance in the niche of that furthest shore and raise the banner of success in those regions, until you are supported by the hosts of the Most Glorious Kingdom and aided by the angels of the Supreme Concourse.

order.why: Direct powerful forces toward comfort and human happiness.
shortened: We must strive with our lives so that these mighty forces are spent on the general happiness and comfort of the human world and become the cause of life rather than destroying the foundation of humanity - that they bestow love upon hearts rather than creating hatred and enmity because of vain imaginings.

order.why: Keep the reported definition of service against bloodshed and rancor.
Link renewed religious truth with the dispersal of war and prejudice.
Name religious, racial and political prejudice as darkness to be dispelled.
Pray for capacities that further oneness and remove prejudice.
shortened: Turn these souls into heavenly angels, resuscitate them through the breath of Thy Holy Spirit, grant them eloquent tongues and resolute hearts, bestow on them heavenly power and merciful susceptibilities, cause them to become the promulgators of the oneness of mankind and the cause of love and concord in the world of humanity, so that the perilous darkness of ignorant prejudice may vanish through the light of the Sun of Truth, this dreary world may become illumined, this material realm may absorb the rays of the world of spirit, these different colors may merge into one color and the melody of praise may rise to the kingdom of Thy sanctity.

order.why: Connect the passing of oppression with justice and fairness.
Ask for estrangement to be transformed into unity.
Read the candle and fragrant offering as a call to shine among others.
Let love kindle the world toward oneness.
shortened: O thou who art enkindled with the fire of the love of God! At this time when stillness and lifelessness have seized the pillars of existence of the people of the world, come thou and kindle a fire of love in the heart of contingent being, and set ablaze the soul of the world, that perchance in this ephemeral dust-heap the spiritual traces of the Eternal Beauty may become manifest and visible, and the divine illumination may dispel the pitch-black darkness of the horizons through the beauty of the Beloved of the horizons, and the morn of oneness may dawn and shine forth.

order.why: Respond to heedlessness by spreading light.
shortened: Lethargy and coldness have encompassed the world - set aflame the heart of the world! Darkness and heedlessness have surrounded creation - spread rays and lights upon the horizons! This flame is the mention of God and these lights are the knowledge of Truth.

order.why: Connect effort and guidance with illuminating hearts.
Read the ray as a call to become a guide.
Follow the passage’s images of awakened and strengthened capacities.
Keep the reported account of a woman’s courageous service.
Read the call to spread the Epistles and dispel prejudice.
Retain the reported account of guidance as service.
shortened: Therefore, the greatest service to be rendered to the human world is to guide it to the right Path, to be the means of the salvation of the souls,- so that the dark ones may become illumined, the defective perfect, the earthly ones, heavenly; extinct ones enlightened; the satanic ones angelic - thus they may all attain to eternal life.

order.why: Identify the hoped-for lamps with the hearers themselves.
Consider how a person’s presence changes a gathering.
shortened: Similarly there are some enkindled souls whose very presence in a meeting changes its atmosphere, suffering the people to become truly spiritual, turning their faces towards God; others like unto the black smoke, darken the horizon of the minds.

order.why: Keep the short hope of souls illuminating the horizon.
Read the promised lamps through Sinai imagery.
shortened: In these days, through the assistance and bounty of the Most Great Unity, I await the appearance of souls who will blaze like an ignited fire in all hearts and who will be raised like a manifest standard from the highest heaven. They shall surge like the waves of the sea and, like a luminous star in the ethereal horizon, shall beam with light and be inspired by the breath of the Holy Spirit. They shall become brilliant lamps and radiant lights shining forth from the Sinai of manifestation.

order.why: Preserve the concise promise of traces and light.
Keep the image of movement giving rise to stars.
Answer encompassing night with each person becoming a lamp.
Let love kindle the candle.
shortened: I hope that all may become bright as the candle through the light of the love of God.

order.why: Apply the address to Diya through its name and purpose.
Keep attention turned toward light in the dark places of life.
shortened: It is my earnest prayer, that ye be not like unto this, but rather that ye keep your faces steadfastly turned to the light, so that ye may be as lighted torches in the dark places of life.

order.why: Turn attention from sedition toward the unobscured sun.
shortened: O My loved ones! Look not upon the sedition and its darkness, but rather gaze upon the Sun from which nothing has withheld It, and be illumined by Its lights from this Quarter unto which the hearts of those near unto God have been attracted.

order.why: Hold the promise of clearing skies beside present clouds.
Retain the brief promise of lifted veils and dawn.
Read the anticipated dispersal of imagined clouds.
Keep the concise assurance of passing darkness.
shortened: This darkness will pass away and the illumination of God's Kingdom will enlighten hearts.

order.why: Preserve the image of dissipating clouds.
shortened: The clouds of vain imaginings have dissipated and the Sun of the horizons has shone forth in utmost beauty.

order.why: Join light with the need for life and spring.
Read the reported image of flowers emerging from dark soil.
shortened: We must make these blind eyes seeing. We must confer hearing to these deaf ears. We must bestow the power of speech to these dumb ones. Then out of this dark soil, which is the world of nature, variegated flowers and fragrant tulips will grow.

order.why: Keep the reported joining of light, knowledge and springtime.
Retain the concise reported insistence on the needed Light.
Keep the reported identification of that light with divine love.
shortened: The world is very dark and the only light which is capable to penetrate through this darkness is the Light of the Love of God and entrance into the Kingdom of Baha'u'llah.

order.why: Preserve the brief reported affirmation of favor.
Hear the remembered exchange about night and the risen sun.
shortened: "What of the dark night, when the Sun is not shining?"
"The darkness of night is past, the Sun has risen."

order.why: Retain the short reported observation about dimness and a veil.
Keep the reported declaration of guidance into Light.
shortened: I raise the dead, I deliver those who are in darkness and guide them into the realm of Light.

order.why: Preserve the reported account of transformation with its historical language.
Keep the original brief selection about a luminous appearance.
shortened: Its light illumines the world and its appearance is the most luminous sun of the Kingdom.

order.why: Retain the particular assessment of India within its source.
shortened: The light of guidance hath shone forth from the supreme horizon, and the star of eternal glory hath risen from the dawning-place of possibility. It is strange that India, despite its capacity, hath not yet been illumined by this effulgence.

order.why: Read the need for a sanctified power that can dispel darkness.
Keep the warning that light can again be extinguished.
shortened: This grace and favor is like unto a lamp. You must know its worth and ever feed this lamp with the oil of detachment and sincerity in the Cause of God, that it may grow brighter day by day and illuminate the world. Otherwise it will be extinguished and darkness will again prevail.

order.why: Retain the prayer to dispel heedlessness and attachment.
Ask directly for a ray of light.
Widen the reported prayer to the whole world.
shortened: I pray that this darkness may be dispelled and the light of the Kingdom may envelop the world.

order.why: Seek an enduring impression in the heart of humanity.
Pray for hearts, spirits and faces to become sources of guidance.
Keep the concise request to lead others toward light.
Keep the blessing addressed through the horizon of tender mercy.
shortened: The glory shining from the horizon of My tender mercy be upon you and upon those who have turned to God on this Day wherein trembling hath seized the inhabitants of all regions, save those whom God hath protected, the Lord of the Day of Judgment.

order.why: Preserve the prayer for protection through the divine Name.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which all darkness hath been dispelled and all light hath dawned forth, and the Face hath been illumined in the heaven of all possibilities, and Beauty hath shone forth in the kingdom of all created things, to guard the bearer of this Tablet through Thy sovereignty and power.

order.why: Pray for every atom to find a door toward presence and reunion.
Close with the blessing of those who turn toward divine exposition amid darkness.
shortened: And glory be upon thee and upon those who have turned toward the Dayspring of the divine exposition in this darkness that hath encompassed the worlds, save whom thy Lord, the Forgiving, the Merciful, hath willed.

questions: How does beginning with love and hatred affect your understanding of the later images of light and darkness?
What distinctions do the readings draw among physical sight, understanding, and spiritual guidance?
How do the dark pupil and the imagery of the beloved’s hair complicate a fixed interpretation of color?
What helps you read severe or martial images in relation to the passages on reconciliation, justice, and life-giving service?
How might acknowledging the limits of understanding change the way we respond to another person’s sorrow or uncertainty?
What would it mean in a particular home, friendship, or community to kindle a lamp through knowledge, love, and action?

references.label: 1 · Qur’an 24:35 · The lamp, the glass, and guidance
references.note: Read the parable of the niche, lamp, glass, and blessed olive tree, attending to its movement from a visible image toward divine guidance. Compare the parallel translations, then return to the compilation’s heart as glass and human reality as a niche. How do these images relate the giving of light to the capacity to receive and share it?
